roadmap_items.notes: Official configurator corpus exists with two user-provided fixture files. Exact configurator version/source reference, exact capture timestamp, and exact push/download route details remain unknown if unavailable. This is not a blocker for routine engineering design.

roadmap_items.notes: Read-only policy/checking is present; source audit planning may proceed. Adapter output generation still requires source authority, license/code-reuse review, and product approval.

roadmap_items.label: Adapter prewrite implementation gate
roadmap_items.notes: Write-capable adapter implementation is not approved unless all blockers are cleared. implementation_allowed=false. Official corpus exists, but exact metadata and write-behavior source authority remain missing. Explicit user product approval after source authority exists is still required.

roadmap_items.notes: Printed RF5 transcription exists; old RF5 negative smoke check remains NOT_TESTED_AMBIGUOUS. RF5 gap index separates the historical row from later GFW3 scope-limited RF5 evidence. Domain input is needed only if the historical ambiguity must be resolved by user/domain statement.
